name: Progressive Leasing
notes: Researched from public Progressive Leasing Help Center articles (read through the help center's public article API) only; never signed in. MyAccount (progleasing.com/myaccount or the app) signs in with email address and password on one page; first-time customers register with Set up online access (email, Social Security number, date of birth and a password; SSN and DOB are not expressible as registration fields). Leases are 12-month lease-to-own agreements; payments are automatic by default from the bank account or card given at application, on the payday frequency chosen at application. One-time payments: from the lease on the dashboard choose Make Payment, then a Custom or Standard payment amount. A card payment is applied to the upcoming scheduled payment(s); a bank (ACH) payment reduces the remaining lease-to-own total and does not replace the next scheduled payment; a Standard payment made more than 3 business days ahead replaces the next scheduled payment; pay about two days before the due date, since payments within 24 hours may apply to the next due date. Auto-pay: Make Payment > Set up auto pay; Make Payment > Manage autopay updates the method. Stopping or rescheduling a payment, changing the payment schedule, cancelling the lease (return the merchandise, owing only unpaid lease-to-own costs) and both early purchase options (90-day, 3 months in CA, and Early Buyout) are done by phone at (877) 898-1970 at least 3 business days before the next payment. If both payment methods fail an NSF fee may apply (amount not published, not modelled). No application or processing fee. Paperless and statement delivery are not described publicly, so they keep the family defaults. Turning Auto-Payments off online is not described publicly (Manage autopay only updates the method and stopping a payment is by phone), so autopay_cancel is unsupported online by inference.

autopay_cancel.note: Automatic payments are part of your lease and cannot be turned off online; Manage autopay only updates the payment method. To stop or reschedule a payment, call (877) 898-1970 at least 3 business days before it is due.

cancel_service.note: You can cancel your lease at any time by returning the items, owing only unpaid lease-to-own costs, but only by phone: call (877) 898-1970.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment changes and early purchase arrangements are set up with a service representative at (877) 898-1970, at least 3 business days before your next payment.

help.title: Make a payment online
paragraphs: Card payments are applied to your upcoming scheduled payment(s). Bank (ACH) payments go toward the remaining lease-to-own total and do not replace your next scheduled payment.

Choose a Custom payment amount for an extra one-time payment, or the Standard payment amount (your regular payment); a Standard payment made more than 3 business days early replaces your next scheduled payment.
Pay about two days before the due date. A payment made within 24 hours of the due date may be applied to the next scheduled payment instead.
You can also pay by phone at (877) 898-1970.
steps: Go to progleasing.com/myaccount or open the Progressive Leasing app.
Log in with your Progressive Leasing credentials.
Find your current lease on the home dashboard and select Make Payment.
Choose the payment amount, verify the payment method and submit.

help.title: Set up Auto-Payments
paragraphs: Payments are automatic by default and follow the payday frequency you gave on your application. If you have been paying manually, or want to go back to Auto-Payments, you can set it up online.
If you have more than one valid payment method you can choose which one Auto-Payments uses.
steps: Log in at progleasing.com/myaccount or in the app.
Find your current lease on the home dashboard and select Make Payment.
Review the payment information, accept the terms and select Submit.

help.title: Change your payment method or stop a payment
paragraphs: To change the account Auto-Payments uses, select Make Payment on your lease, then Manage autopay, update the payment information, accept the terms and select Save Changes. A card added online is available for one-time payments but does not become your primary payment method by itself.
To stop or reschedule a payment, call (877) 898-1970 at least 3 business days before the scheduled payment. After that deadline the payment can't be changed and will be processed.
If a payment fails, Progressive tries your secondary payment method; if both fail, an NSF fee may apply.

help.title: How payments work
paragraphs: You can pay automatically or make one-time payments. Automatic payments come from your bank account or debit/credit card on the payday schedule from your application.
One-time payments can be made online or by phone. Card payments count toward your upcoming payments; bank (ACH) payments are in addition to scheduled payments, which keep processing.
Progressive Leasing does not charge an application or processing fee. Your first payment is charged to the card you approved in the lease agreement and is part of the 12-month lease-to-own total.

help.title: Early purchase options
paragraphs: The standard agreement is 12 months. Paying early lowers your total and lets you own the items sooner.

90-day option (3 months in California): buy out the lease within the first 90 days for the cash price plus the lease-to-own cost for those 90 days. It saves the most, and you must call to set it up; after that you can pay online in MyAccount.
Early Buyout: available during the whole 12-month term, priced as a percentage of the unpaid 12-month total. Call to arrange it, or make a one-time online payment to pay the account in full.

help.title: Cancel your lease
paragraphs: You can cancel your lease at any time. You may return the items without extra charges or penalties and owe only unpaid lease-to-own costs.
If you can no longer afford your payments, call Customer Service at (877) 898-1970 to discuss your options.

help.title: View your payment history
paragraphs: Log in and open the More menu under your current buyout option, then choose Payment activity to see your payments. Select Receipts or See All to view every attempted payment, successful and unsuccessful.
steps: Open the More menu beneath your buyout option.
Select Receipts or See All for every attempt.

extra.intent: You want to make an extra payment on your Progressive Leasing lease. Using Progressive's help center, find out whether a bank (ACH) one-time payment replaces your next scheduled payment. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: No. A bank (ACH) payment goes toward the remaining lease-to-own total and does not replace the next scheduled payment; card payments go toward upcoming payments.

extra.intent: You want to use the 90-day purchase option on your Progressive Leasing lease. Using Progressive's help center, find out how to exercise it and report the phone number. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: You must call a service representative at (877) 898-1970 to set up the 90-day purchase option.

extra.intent: Using Progressive Leasing's help center, find out how many business days in advance a Standard payment amount must be made to replace your next scheduled payment. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: More than 3 business days in advance.
